subject: AWS private offer: delegated buyer approvals & term flexibility
messages:
From: Amrita Singh <amrita@brightware.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurements@brightware.com
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer questions — buyer delegation + term options

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo last week — BrightWare is excited about Redwood's latency profile for inference. Procurement is starting to scope the private offer for a pilot across two business units. Two quick questions before we move to the PO:

1) Our procurement team needs clarity on "delegated buyer" setups — can a named purchaser in our BU sign for a 12/24 month private offer, or does it require central procurement approval for any >12 month term?
2) We have one BU that wants a 24-month discounted rate; will that trigger an additional approval path on Redwood's side (sales leader signoff, finance)?

Can you share the approval ladder and any templated PO language you recommend so we can start internal approvals?

Also copied Kenji from our platform team who asked about accelerated activation if we commit to two-year terms.

Thanks,
Amrita
Amrita Singh
Head of Procurement, BrightWare Inc.
procurements@brightware.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amrita Singh <amrita@brightware.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer questions — buyer delegation + term options

Hi Amrita — great to hear from you, and glad the demo was useful. Short answers up front, then a suggested next step:

- Delegated buyers: We support named delegated buyers for private offers (buyer-level signature) for pilots up to 12 months without central procurement involvement. For terms >12 months, our standard flow commonly requires procurement signoff + AM/sales leader approval to validate discounting and SLA tiers.
- 24-month approvals: Yes — two-year commitments usually go through a quick internal review (sales leader + finance) because they impact revenue recognition and discount bands. We can usually complete this in 48–72 hours if you supply the PO draft and expected ARR.

I'll attach our private-offer template and a one-page buyer-delegation matrix that outlines who can sign for which term/discount band. If you'd like, we can nominate Jordan to be the internal Redwood approver for this deal to accelerate signoff.

Next step: If you can drop the draft PO into the Drive link below (or attach it here), Jordan and I will triage and confirm which approvals we need and whether we can keep the BU-level purchaser as the signer.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/redwood/brightware/PO-3145
Attachments: redwood-private-offer-template-2028-03.xlsx; buyer-delegation-matrix.pdf

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amrita Singh <amrita@brightware.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Mar 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer questions — buyer delegation + term options

Thanks Amrita, Naomi — looping in technical + pricing context. A couple of internal notes so BrightWare knows what to expect:

- For a 24-month term at a discounted rate we typically require: sales leader (Vivek) approval for discount >20%, and a short finance review to confirm ARR recognition. We can do an accelerated review if the BU signs and procurement confirms they accept standard PO/legal clauses.
- If you want to keep the BU purchaser as the named signer, we need a signed delegated authority letter or a procurement-stamped memo indicating delegated signing rights. The buyer-delegation-matrix Naomi attached clarifies acceptable artifacts.

Operationally, if BrightWare commits to two-year and requests accelerated activation, we can prioritize capacity in our Dedicated pool for the pilot (subject to calendar availability). That can be part of the PO as an activation milestone.

Jordan Blake
Director, Marketplace Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Amrita Singh <amrita@brightware.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kenji Watanabe <kenji@acmecloud.com>, procurements@brightware.com
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer questions — buyer delegation + term options

Thanks Jordan/Naomi — helpful clarity. Two updates from our side:

1) Procurement confirmed they will provide a delegation memo that lists our BU purchasers and gives them signing authority for pilot-level POs (we'll attach it to the PO).
2) BU A wants the 24-month discounted rate; BU B will take 12 months. Could you confirm whether we should split into two private offers (one 24m/one 12m) or a single consolidated PO with per-BU attachments to avoid dual approval flows?

Also, Kenji asked whether the activation milestone can be tied to a Schedule A in the PO (we'd like Redwood to commit to activation within 10 business days after signature if we do 24 months).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — aiming to route this internally this week.

Best,
Amrita

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amrita Singh <amrita@brightware.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer questions — buyer delegation + term options

Hi Amrita — quick confirmation from our side:

- We can accept a consolidated PO with per-BU addenda. That keeps the commercial relationship as a single PO (simpler for billing) while allowing different term lengths per BU in Schedule A. Our legal team will need to review the consolidated structure but we don't anticipate blockers.
- Activation milestone: we can commit to the 10 business day activation for the 24-month BU if the PO includes an activation schedule and the BU provides the delegated authority memo at signature. We'll mark this as priority in our onboarding queue.
- Approval path: because there's a 24-month term at a materially discounted rate, we'll run a lightweight finance check. Jordan and Vanessa will handle the internal signoffs; with the documents in Drive we should be able to complete approvals within 48 hours.

I'll ask Vanessa to put the approval ticket in our internal tracker and flag finance. Jordan — please proceed once the PO draft is uploaded.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
